businesses.business: healthcare experience management and governance services

offering_description.value: Provides hospitals, health systems, and medical groups with an AI-enabled platform that collects and analyzes feedback to improve patient, consumer, and workforce experiences. It also serves nonprofit hospital and health system leaders through a governance membership that delivers research, education, conferences, and advisory services.

quotes.quote: Our comprehensive platform is a next-generation suite of AI enabled products that create a natural way to collect, analyze, and deliver feedback.

The Governance Institute, a service of NRC Health, is a membership organization serving not-for-profit hospital and health system board chairs, board members, healthcare executives, and physician and nurse leaders. Membership services are provided through research and publications, online learning, conferences, and advisory services.
